text:
jenna-pm: ok team — planning dedicated rollout for tenant 'granary' tomorrow 02:00 UTC. Need final go/no-go. Release notes: https://docs.internal/release/granary-v2.3.1-rc2. Plan: canary -> 5% for 30m, ramp to 25% then 100%. pin to v2.3.1-rc2. KMS rotation is currently scheduled at 03:00 UTC and might collide with our window. proposing quiet window 01:50-03:10. @mike-ops @ada-dev please ack or call out blockers

mike-ops: FYI KMS rotation is org-wide at 03:00. I can shift it ~20m earlier to 02:40 or scope the rotate out for granary only. Prefer shifting so other tenants unaffected. any objections? :thinking_face:

ada-dev: we need the image pinned by digest or the autoscaler may pull an unintended build. I'll add the image pin now. snippet:
```
image: ghcr.io/redwood/inference-runtime@sha256:abcdef1234deadbeef
```
Also will pin the model artifact to model_id: granary/v1@sha256:feedface

sophia-sre: SLO check — canary must run at 5% for 30m with P95 < 120ms. Rollback triggers: error_rate > 2% sustained over 5m OR p95 > 2x baseline. I'll watch dashboards and trace alerts. Leaving pager on. :eyeglasses:

deploybot: deploybot: starting canary for tenant granary -> image v2.3.1-rc2, route 5%. CI: green. logs: https://deploylogs/internal/6509873210. status: 🟢

mike-ops: ack on shifting KMS to 02:40 UTC instead of 03:00. jenna can you update the calendar & release notes?

jenna-pm: updated calendar and release notes, moved KMS to 02:40. quiet window set to 01:50-03:10. added rollback plan and contact list in the notes.

thomas-eng: +1 from eng lead. one ask: ensure rollback toggle is exposed in console and fallback policy targets v2.2.9 immediate. ops, confirm we can flip without DB migration issues.

ada-dev: confirm fallback artifact (v2.2.9-hotfix) is staged in bucket and the service supports instant switch — no DB migrations in this rollout. I uploaded artifact: s3://releases/granary/v2.2.9-hotfix.tar.gz

deploybot: deploybot: canary metrics at +15m: error_rate=0.4% p95=98ms. continuing.

sophia-sre: looks healthy at 15m mark. recommend ramp to 25% now and monitor for 25m window. will escalate if triggers hit.

jenna-pm: ramping to 25% at +20m. final signoff please.

mike-ops: ops ack. I'll be on pager and have rollback steps ready. :rotating_light:

thomas-eng: go for launch. :rocket:
